title: ECG Heartbeat Classifier on MIT-BIH
tools: Python · SciPy (Butterworth and notch filters, Welch PSD, power spectral density) · wfdb · matplotlib
blurb: An ECG (electrocardiogram) heartbeat pipeline on MIT-BIH; so far it loads all 48 records (109,494 beats) and filters out 56.4 dB of powerline hum.
long: An end-to-end heartbeat classifier on ECG (electrocardiogram) data: filter the signal, detect beats with a hand-written Pan-Tompkins detector, and classify them, tested on unseen patients rather than a random beat split, to measure data leakage.
Done so far: a loader for all 48 MIT-BIH records (109,494 beats), and zero-phase filtering that removes 56.4 dB of powerline hum and 29.8 dB of drift while leaving the heartbeat band unchanged.
The detector, features and classifier are next.
highlights: Hum −56.4 dB, drift −29.8 dB, QRS band 0.0 dB
One-pass filter delay differs by beat shape: 11.1 vs 8.3 ms
